proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING RACIAL EQUITY AUDIT
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust (SEIU)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to oversee a racial equity audit analyzing Oracle's impacts on non-white stakeholders and communities of color, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIR
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a policy requiring the Chairman of the Board to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING POLITICAL SPENDING
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Oracle to require third-party organizations receiving its funds that engage in political activities to report annually their political expenditures, posted publicly.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 7.
